parts.name: Rubber feet
parts.notes: search: 10mm self adhesive rubber bumper feet; stick under the body corners

parts.name: Mini breadboard (170 points)
parts.notes: search: mini breadboard 170 tie points 47x35mm (usually a 6-pack ~$7). Used as the 5V/GND power strip; stands on edge against the right wall on its adhesive back. A full-size kit breadboard won't fit inside.

parts.name: Dupont jumper wires 10-20 cm (F-F, F-M, M-M)
parts.notes: search: dupont jumper wires female female male kit; skip if your ELEGOO kit has jumpers. 11 used: F-F ESP32 to OLED, F-M ESP32 to breadboard/servo, M-M breadboard to servo plug

parts.name: 470 uF 10 V electrolytic capacitor
parts.notes: search: electrolytic capacitor assortment kit; legs plug into the breadboard across 5V/GND so the ESP32 doesn't reset when the servo starts

parts.name: Double-sided foam tape
parts.notes: search: double sided foam mounting tape; a 20 mm strip holds the ESP32 (upside down, on its metal module can) in the cradle

parts.name: USB-C cable 1 m
parts.notes: search: USB-C to USB-A cable 1m; any 5 V phone charger of 1 A or more powers it

parts.name: M3×10 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M3 x 10mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic

parts.name: M2×6 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M2 x 6mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic
